## Reviewable Claims

From this subset the owner can review exactly:

- whether ODQ-001F should select Disposition B as the development and
  qualification architecture;
- whether the candidate is baseline-relative and adequately protected against
  overfitting, multiplicity, dependence, post-hoc exclusion, support
  withholding, truth-driven stopping, historical-role conflation, and
  downstream-authority leakage;
- whether method, claim, evidence, and decision identities are adequately
  separated; and
- whether all effects and non-effects of ODQ-001F approval are explicit.

## Claims Not Reviewable From This Subset

This subset intentionally omits the complete Stage A recovery dossier and
cannot establish or decide:

- the historical recurrence details or additive-equivalence proof;
- ODQ-001 or ODQ-001A–D state/update semantics;
- parent-route admission or exact historical-control execution profile;
- a profile, applicability domain, sampling population, metric equation,
  threshold, parameter/adaptation policy, stopping rule, recurrence, or method;
- scientific-contract contents, implementation conformity, validation,
  achieved performance, readiness, production, or fallback availability.

Those omitted objects remain available in the full package and are enumerated
by the manifest. They are not silently summarized into authority here.

## Exact Decision Boundary

ODQ-001F remains open. Approval must identify the exact final candidate and
the exact manifest revision. A short acceptance of an earlier sentence is not
sufficient.

**ODQ-001F approval selects a development and qualification architecture.**

**It does not select ODQ-001 recurrence treatment, ODQ-001A–D state/update
semantics, a parent route, or a numerical method.**

**It does not launch the empirical lane.**

This subset is not an implementation-blind Stage B author packet and does not
authorize development, qualification, implementation inspection, benchmark
execution, data access, validation, readiness, production, or Unity work.

## Supersession

For ODQ-001F owner review, this `r0.8` focused subset supersedes the generated
